s01.text: ሁለት ሺህ አሥራ ሁለት ዓመተ ምሕረት። እኩለ ቀን ላይ ከአንኮበር ተነሳሁ። አንድ የጀርባ ቦርሳ ብቻ ይዤ። አንድ ጓደኛዬ ሸኘኝ።
s01.subtitle: It was 2012 in the Ethiopian calendar. At midday I left Ankober. Just one backpack. A friend saw me off.

subtitle_check.literal: Two thousand twelve, Year of Mercy. At midday I set out from Ankober. Carrying only one backpack. A friend of mine saw me off.

s02.text: እስከ ደብረ ብርሃን መንገዱ ፒስታ ነበር። ከዚያ በኋላ አስፋልት።
s02.subtitle: The road was gravel as far as Debre Birhan. After that, asphalt.

subtitle_check.literal: Up to Debre Birhan the road was gravel (unpaved). After that, asphalt.

s03.text: በአውቶቡሱ መስኮት በኩል ተቀምጬ ነበር። ውጪው ደንና ተራራ ነው። እይታው ድንቅ ነበር።
s03.subtitle: I sat by the window of the bus. Outside, forest and mountains. The view was amazing.

subtitle_check.literal: I was sitting by the window of the bus. Outside is forest and mountain. The view was wonderful.

s04.text: ላምበረት የደረስኩት ከመሸ በኋላ ነው። ጓደኛዬ እዚያው ጠበቀኝ። ሰው፣ መብራት፣ መኪና፤ ሁሉም በአንድ ጊዜ።
s04.subtitle: I reached Lamberet after dark. My friend was there, waiting for me. People, lights, cars: everything at once.

subtitle_check.literal: It was after dark that I reached Lamberet. My friend waited for me right there. People, lights, cars; all at once.

s06.text: አውቶቡስ ተራ ስንደርስ ደላሎች ከበቡን። «አልጋ ትፈልጋላችሁ?» «አልጋ?» ከየአቅጣጫው። ግራ ገባን። በመጨረሻ አንዱን መረጥን።
s06.subtitle: At Autobus Tera the brokers closed in on us. "Do you want a bed?" "A bed?" From every side. We were lost. In the end we picked one.

subtitle_check.literal: When we arrived at Autobus Tera, brokers surrounded us. "Do you want a bed?" "A bed?" From every direction. We were confused. In the end we chose one.

s07.text: ክፍሉ ባለ አንድ አልጋ ነበር። በጣም ጥሩ አይደለም፣ መጥፎም አይደለም። ንጹሕ ነበር።
s07.subtitle: The room had one bed. Not very good, not bad. It was clean.

subtitle_check.literal: The room was a one-bed room. Not very good, and not bad either. It was clean.

s08.text: ጠዋት ረጅም ሰልፍ ተሰልፈን ትኬት ቆረጥን።
s08.subtitle: In the morning we stood in a long queue and got the ticket.

subtitle_check.literal: In the morning we stood in a long line and bought tickets.

s09.text: ያ ሌሊት ግራ አጋባኝ። ዛሬ ግን ከቤቱ ለሚወጣ ሁሉ አንድ ነገር እላለሁ፦ የመጀመሪያው ሌሊት ሁሌም ግራ ያጋባል። አትሽሽ። አጣጥመው።
s09.subtitle: That night confused me. Today I tell everyone who leaves home one thing: the first night is always confusing. Do not run from it. Savour it.

subtitle_check.literal: That night confused me. But today I say one thing to everyone who leaves home: the first night always confuses. Do not flee. Savour it.
